solution: Let $S=\cos\tfrac{\pi}{7}+\cos\tfrac{3\pi}{7}+\cos\tfrac{5\pi}{7}$. Multiply by $2\sin\tfrac{\pi}{7}$ and use $2\sin A\cos B=\sin(A+B)+\sin(A-B)$: $2S\sin\tfrac{\pi}{7}=(\sin\tfrac{2\pi}{7}-\sin0)+(\sin\tfrac{4\pi}{7}-\sin\tfrac{2\pi}{7})+(\sin\tfrac{6\pi}{7}-\sin\tfrac{4\pi}{7})=\sin\tfrac{6\pi}{7}=\sin\tfrac{\pi}{7}$. Hence $2S=1$ and $S=\tfrac12$.
